description: Create a public link to one of your Besidka artifacts. Anyone who has the link can open the artifact, no account needed, and can report it; copies others make cannot be recalled. The link expires after the days you give (at most 30), is never indexed by search engines, does not let visitors save progress or use AI features, and shows in your link list as created by this app. At most 10 links a day can be created through connected apps, and an artifact can have 10 active links. The result lists warnings when the shared version seems to contain emails, phone numbers or similar identifiers. Only share what the user asked to publish, and revoke a link with revoke_artifact_shares. Requires signing in (artifacts:share).

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link stops working, 1 to 30. Required

pinnedVersion.description: Show this version only; default the latest version, which follows later updates

name: share_artifact
title: Publish an artifact as a public link
